item.title: Seisoji Temple & Mountain Trail: A Combined Temple Visit and Forest Hike — Guide
item.description: Seisoji Temple sits on a forested mountainside in Fukui, pairing a peaceful Buddhist temple complex with an accompanying hiking trail that winds through the surrounding forest, giving visitors the chance to combine spiritual sightseeing with light outdoor exercise in a single visit. The trail offers a genuinely rewarding forest walk beyond the temple grounds themselves, with the mountain setting providing a quiet, natural backdrop considerably removed from Fukui’s more urban sights.
